featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Pawar-Master Reviewer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sometimes it becomes really tough to distinguish between stale fishes and a fresh catch. It can grow harder especially for newbies and upcoming kitchen enthusiasts just like me. But recently I have found my saviour to this problem! And that's 'Cambay Tiger'. No, it is not associated with Onitsuka Tiger in any way :)
Cambay Tiger is a premium store that offers wide range of fresh fishes and different types of meat to choose from.
I got to know from the manager that their  parent company is into this business since 1997. That makes them almost a 30 years old entity in this space.
Initially they became famous for their fresh & enormous sized Tiger Prawns and thus 'Tiger' in their store name.
I have been buying all my meat and seafood essentials from this store only since past 3-4 months and I just adore the service and quality I get every time.
They have their own aquaculture farm so you can be rest assured about the quality of the meat, its freshness and back tracking any product if you wish to.
They follow a 'farm-to-fork' business model and so you can get all your cooking needs under one roof, be it meat, fishes, spices, ready to cook curries, masalas etc.
All the fishes and meat products are cleaned thoroughly before packing them in the most hygienic fashion.
All in all, it's THE BEST place to go if you are looking for a one-stop-shop for your fish and meat requirements.
100% approved and recommended!

Cheers!!

Tiny little restaurant,  but seriously,  some of the best seafood in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Raut (Vedanta)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jai Hind Lunch Home,  Pali Naka,  Bandra (west)

Jai Hind is a brightest shining star of the galaxy of coastal cuisine restaurants in Mumbai.  With the few branches spread across the city,  this branch at Bandra,  Pali Naka is their first branch.  The other one is on the Linking Road, which seems to be rather spacious and well furnished.  But as a foodie, my hunt is always for a 'Value for money'  restaurants with excellent quality and quantity and this desire of mime gets fulfilled only in humble homely restaurants.  This branch at Pali Naka has been renovated recently and has only five tables in all.  I recommend to reserve a table in the evening as its a very old and famous restaurant in the area and gets filled quite soon.

The list of dishes we ordered :

1.  Patra Ni Macchi (Basa)
2. Bombil Thali
3. Chicken Sukka Thali

Let me begin with the most yummiest first. The chicken sukka was simply top quality stuff made with supreme perfection. It was creamy with great blend of masalas and literally made us lick our fingers till the end.  The chicken pieces were one of the softest and well marinated ones I ever had.  The Bombil was crispy and crunchy on the outside and soft juicy within. The soul kadi (pink broth)  was thick and made with actual coconut milk.  The texture of the chapatis were homely and rice was soft, fresh and well cooked.

Patra Ni Macchi was steamed to ultimate perfection,  which retained the original flavour of the soft melting Basa fish.  The green stuffing on it was blend of spicy and sour.

Over all,  A must visit restaurant..
Staff is helpful

Update !!

- Chicken Sukka thali - 5 stars 🤩- Delicious gravy with softest chicken.

- Egg Biryani  - 5 stars🤩  - Long grained rice with perfect blend of spices and 2 boiled eggs.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanga CrewForShoots
featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful interior with good ambiance. They have musical nights as Thursday seems Karaoke night. Lots of people to sing. Food is not bad but average. Service is not bad too. Very attentive servers. Street parking only.

featured_reviews.name: Merlyn
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had originally checked with Soul Fry for their karaoke nights, but the owner mentioned that reservations usually need to be made around 10 days to 2 weeks in advance. Later, we ended up going there for lunch on one of the days. I had even called beforehand to ask if reservations were necessary, and he said yes, definitely. But when we actually reached, the restaurant was pretty empty.

The food was good — nothing extremely standout, but overall decent. One thing we did feel though was that everything was slightly on the pricier side for what was offered. That being said, the interiors really give you that old-school Goan tavern vibe, which added a nice charm to the experience.

featured_reviews.name: george joseph
featured_reviews.review_text: What a find. A cute little restaurant with goan vibes right in bandra. You would need to plan to be there around opening time if you want to get a seat in their cozy indoor area. They close for the evening making it a little exclusive with the time restriction. The food was really good. We ordered a chicken starter along with the prawn curry rice and pork vindaloo. The prawn curry rice combo is a must try. Coming from Kerala it gave me those beach vibes. The curry is runny and just perfect with rice. It felt just like it was made at home. The pork was incredible. The pieces they had in the vindaloo consisted of fat and flesh you always die for. Not a lot of places get this right. It was a little too sweet for my usual vindaloo but nonetheless tasty. We could not get an inside sitting spot but consider yourself lucky if you do. I'm sure the experience would be worth it. One of the best places i have visited in bandra.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwinth Naveen
featured_reviews.review_text: My first time in Mumbai, and I have absolutely no regrets choosing Soul Fry as my go-to spot! The karaoke night was an absolute blast and made the whole experience even more memorable. The vibe, music, and overall atmosphere were amazing, and I genuinely had such a great time. Definitely one of the highlights of my trip — would love to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Marlyn Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text: If you’re into authentic Goan food this is a great place to be. They have karaoke in the evenings and is usually packed so you might have to book in advance, or take only outside seating. The bombil fry and pompfret rechado is a must try.

featured_reviews.name: DS
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of my favourite places in Mumbai. They have karaoke nights and also other events happening everyday. When we visited, there was a live music and karaoke night happening. They have a nice variety of cocktails and liquor available. We also tried their prawn rava fry and it was absolutely superb.

It does get extremely crowded on the weekends so getting a table will be difficult. But they let you stand around and order and also have free peanuts. Nice place for seafood.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kids Friendly place.
This place is divided into different sections, the entry is free.

*Fish park - this park is quite big and has 3 gates,
The first half has fish tanks, selfie point and a fountain
Currently there are only few fishes, the fountain is shut and the empty tanks are not maintained well (due to COVID)

*The cricket ground - usually there is local cricket match on weekends, chairs are provided for audience.

*Kids play area- there are slides, swings, and play area for kids.

*Open Gym- they have a gym area near the second gate, which is currently closed for public, equipments are mainted nicely.

*Walking / jogging track - there is a long walking and jogging track around the park, local residents usually come visit for morning and evening walks

*Accessibility - park is partially Accessibility as there are stairs in some parts of the park. This place is ideal for kids, family and senior citizens.
The fish park gate is accessible but to reach the other area it is ideal to use the second gate which has a slope.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Rambade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently stayed at Fisherman Village for a monsoon staycation, and it turned out to be a really refreshing and peaceful experience. The moment we entered the property, the entire place felt calm, scenic, and surrounded by nature. Since we visited during the rainy season, everything looked extra beautiful — lush greenery, cloudy weather, the peaceful lake view, and ducks swimming around made the atmosphere feel straight out of a nature retreat.

One of the best parts of the stay was the ambience. The property has a very relaxing vibe, perfect for taking a break from the city rush. Sitting near the lake with light rain and cool weather felt extremely soothing. The view throughout the property was beautiful, especially during the evenings and early mornings. If you enjoy nature, monsoon is definitely the best time to visit.❤️

The food was also very good. The meals were fresh, tasty, and comforting, which added a lot to the overall experience. The staff was polite and welcoming, and the stay overall felt smooth and comfortable.✨

What we loved most was how peaceful and well-maintained the place felt. Whether it was walking around the property, enjoying the lake view, or simply relaxing with family and friends, the entire experience was memorable.🫶🏼

Overall, it was a wonderful staycation experience with beautiful views, good food, and a calm atmosphere. We genuinely enjoyed our stay and would definitely love to visit again, especially during the monsoon season. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway near nature.👌

featured_reviews.name: Vijayshri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Khar Gymkhana, an iconic club founded in the late 1920s by a group of influential sports enthusiasts, has a rich history of nurturing talent and hosting prestigious tournaments. Over the decades, it has become a hub for a wide range of indoor and outdoor sports. The club offers excellent facilities for games like table tennis, billiards, cards, tennis, cricket, and swimming. In addition to the sports, Khar Gymkhana also boasts a popular restaurant called The Pavilion, known for its diverse menu of  food and drinks.

Membership to Khar Gymkhana is exclusive, with life membership available to individuals either within the immediate family or those married into a family that holds membership. There are also other types of memberships that can be obtained.

During our visit, we enjoyed a nice lunch and had time to observe some of the ongoing activities and games around the club. The food was delicious, and the service was surprisingly fast, considering the large crowd the restaurant was catering to. From the starters to the desserts, everything—whether vegetarian or non-vegetarian—was prepared well. However, there was one issue: the club lacked sufficient wheelchairs. A senior citizen in our group had to wait for a while to get access to one, as it was already in use by another member.
